note: Intermediate objectives. Each entry names a check implemented in GameLogic/Objectives.py; each reward is a standing commitment: it is folded into the superpower's score only while the objective holds, and is lost again if it stops holding (see the notes in GameLogic/Objectives.py).

objectives.title: Hold your alliance together
objectives.detail: Every listed ally of your bloc must hold a higher treaty with you than with the other superpower. One defection fails it.

objectives.title: Keep the Gulf on your side
objectives.detail: At least two of Iraq, Saudi Arabia and Iran must think better of you than of your rival.

objectives.title: Gain ground in the unaligned world
objectives.detail: Your sphere of influence must end up larger than it was in 1982.

objectives.title: Keep the world calm to 1985
objectives.detail: World tension must never rise above 100 before the end of 1985. One breach loses it for good.

objectives.title: Do not lose your clients
objectives.detail: No more than three countries that were your formal allies in 1982 may leave you.
